description: This file manages task execution workflows, including creating, starting, progressing, completing, failing, and canceling task runs and flows. It handles task flow management, task state updates, and flow cancellation logic within a task execution system.

methods.name: isOneTaskFlowEligible
methods.description: Checks if a task is eligible to have a single task flow created based on its parentFlowId, scopeKind, deliveryStatus, and runtime.

methods.name: ensureSingleTaskFlow
methods.description: Creates and links a task flow for a task if eligible, handling errors and cleanup.

methods.name: createQueuedTaskRun
methods.description: Creates a new task record with status 'queued' and potentially links it to a task flow.

methods.name: getFlowTaskSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of tasks associated with a specific flow ID.

methods.name: createRunningTaskRun
methods.description: Creates a new task record with status 'running' and potentially links it to a task flow.

methods.name: startTaskRunByRunId
methods.description: Marks a task run as running based on its run ID.

methods.name: recordTaskRunProgressByRunId
methods.description: Records progress for a task run identified by run ID.

methods.name: completeTaskRunByRunId
methods.description: Marks a task run as succeeded with completion details.

methods.name: failTaskRunByRunId
methods.description: Marks a task run as failed or timed out with error details.

methods.name: markTaskRunLostById
methods.description: Marks a task run as lost.

methods.name: setDetachedTaskDeliveryStatusByRunId
methods.description: Updates delivery status for a detached task run.

methods.name: resolveRetryableBlockedFlowTask
methods.description: Determines if a flow's latest task is eligible for retry based on its status and outcome.

methods.name: retryBlockedFlowTask
methods.description: Retries a blocked flow by creating a new task record if eligible.

methods.name: retryBlockedFlowAsQueuedTaskRun
methods.description: Retries a blocked flow as a queued task run.

methods.name: retryBlockedFlowAsRunningTaskRun
methods.description: Retries a blocked flow as a running task run.

methods.name: isActiveTaskStatus
methods.description: Checks if a task status is 'queued' or 'running'.

methods.name: isTerminalFlowStatus
methods.description: Checks if a flow status is terminal ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'lost').

methods.name: markFlowCancelRequested
methods.description: Marks a flow as cancel requested if not already marked.

methods.name: cancelManagedFlowAfterChildrenSettle
methods.description: Updates a flow to 'cancelled' after its children settle.

methods.name: mapRunTaskInFlowCreateError
methods.description: Maps errors during task creation in a flow to a result object.

methods.name: runTaskInFlow
methods.description: Runs a task within a flow, creating a queued or running task record.

methods.name: runTaskInFlowForOwner
methods.description: Runs a task within a flow for a specific owner, verifying ownership.

methods.name: cancelFlowById
methods.description: Cancels a flow and its active tasks, updating flow status.

methods.name: runTaskInFlowForOwner
methods.description: Runs a task in a flow for a specific owner, with ownership verification.

methods.name: cancelFlowByIdForOwner
methods.description: Cancels a flow for a specific owner.

methods.name: cancelDetachedTaskRunById
methods.description: Cancels a detached task run by ID.
